finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js#L6) | `retries` renamed `retryCount` | Read new name, fall back to old |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js#L7) | Unset flag now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat absent as `false` |

The 8 warnings left are real deprecations. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is flagged for removal before v5. Worth a separate pass.
